notes: 64 MP main + 8 MP 119° UW + 2 MP mono. Discontinued; final OS OxygenOS 13 (Android 13), now EOL.
caveats: 119° advertised UW is a comfortable spec pass, but third-party reachability is the blocker: on OxygenOS 11 aux cameras were package-name-whitelisted ('snapcam' GCam ports only), and the final OxygenOS 12/13 (ColorOS codebase) blocks aux cameras for ALL third-party apps fleet-wide; the documented restoration (C.44) covered only the OnePlus 9 series, never the Nord line. No evidence the logical back camera exposes CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO < 1.0 to third parties (OnePlus historically uses the separate-ID model when exposed at all) - expect runtime compat-check rejection. ARCore certified (listed as 'OnePlus Nord CE') - good IMU + camera/IMU timestamp proxy. Snapdragon 750G HEVC encoder is in the reliable Qualcomm Venus family, but CBR support must still be confirmed via EncoderCapabilities.isBitrateModeSupported(). EOL since 2023: no security updates.

notes: 64 MP main + 8 MP 119° UW + 2 MP macro. Discontinued; final OS OxygenOS 13 (Android 13), now EOL. GSMArena confirms 8 MP f/2.2 119° UW.
caveats: 119° advertised UW passes on paper, but the device launched on the ColorOS-based OxygenOS 11.3 and ended on OxygenOS 13 - the OS family with the documented fleet-wide third-party aux-camera block (restoration only ever confirmed for OnePlus 9 series). Zoom-ratio-below-1.0 exposure unverified; expect runtime compat-check rejection. ARCore certified (listed as 'OnePlus Nord CE 2' on the official page - resolves the recon snapshot ambiguity in the certified-families extract). ENCODER RISK: MediaTek Dimensity 900 - WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT for all MTK encoders (rate control ignores frame timestamps, so CBR target can drift under real frame-rate variance), and budget/mid MTK parts have documented HEVC Surface-input timestamp jitter; CBR support must be probed and the encoder treated as unvalidated. EOL since 2023: no security updates.

notes: India-focused. 50 MP IMX890 main (OIS) + 8 MP 112° UW + 2 MP macro. Discontinued. OxygenOS 15 (Android 15) stable confirmed rolled out.
caveats: Two stacked UW risks: (1) 112° advertised FOV is marginal against the >=110° computed-dFOV gate - little headroom once computed from sensor geometry; (2) third-party reachability is negative-leaning - community GCam guidance for this exact model requires the power-off/install-immediately-after-boot trick to reach the ultrawide, which means aux camera IDs are hidden from normally-installed third-party apps on its OxygenOS 13/14/15 (ColorOS-base) firmware. ARCore certified (listed as 'OnePlus Nord CE 3 5G') - good IMU + timestamp proxy. Snapdragon 782G HEVC encoder is reliable-family Qualcomm; CBR support still needs the isBitrateModeSupported() probe.

notes: India-only launch (Apr 2024). 50 MP LYT-600 main (OIS) + 8 MP 112° UW. Android 16 (OxygenOS 16, build CPH2613_16.0.2.400 EX01) confirmed rolling out. NOTE: do not confuse with Nord CE4 Lite, which has NO ultrawide.
caveats: 112° advertised UW is marginal against the >=110° computed-dFOV gate, AND its OxygenOS 14/15/16 (ColorOS base) is the OS family that blocks aux cameras for third-party apps - no positive evidence of zoom-ratio or separate-ID UW access for normally-installed apps on this model. NOT found on the official ARCore supported-devices list (oddly, the UW-less Nord CE4 Lite IS listed) - so the IMU-calibration/REALTIME-timestamp proxy is absent; SENSOR_INFO_TIMESTAMP_SOURCE may report UNKNOWN. IMU hardware at this 2024 upper-midrange Snapdragon tier very likely sustains 100 Hz, but it is unverified. Snapdragon 7 Gen 3 HEVC encoder is reliable-family Qualcomm; CBR probe still required. QA must not conflate with Nord CE4 Lite (no ultrawide - excluded outright).

notes: India launch Jul 8 2025 alongside Nord 5. 50 MP LYT-600 main + 8 MP 112° UW (16mm f/2.2, fixed focus). 7,100 mAh battery. 4 OS generations + 6 years security promised; OxygenOS 16 (Android 16, CPH2717_16.0.1.300 EX01) confirmed rolling out Nov 2025 - android_max will rise beyond 16 over its support life.
caveats: Three stacked unknowns. (1) UW: 112° advertised is marginal vs the >=110° computed-dFOV gate, and OxygenOS 15/16 (ColorOS base) is the OS family with the third-party aux-camera block - no evidence of zoom-ratio<1.0 or separate-ID UW exposure on this model. (2) ENCODER: Dimensity 8350 Apex sits in the 'mixed' Dimensity 8000-class bucket - all MTK encoders carry the WebRTC FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT caveat (rate control assumes configured fps, ignores frame timestamps, so CBR bitrate can drift); isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) must be verified, never trusted from configure() silence. (3) Not on the official ARCore list as of 2026-06 (may be listing lag for a Jul-2025 device) - no IMU/timestamp calibration proxy; REALTIME timestamp source unverified. On the plus side: efficient 4nm SoC + 7,100 mAh makes the 25-min thermal/battery gate plausible, and GMS/Play Integrity is standard.
